name: Find My AI Tool

sources.title: Submit AI Tool — plans, FAQ, and pay-first flow

requirements: AI tools only; every submission is reviewed by the team before going live
Payment comes first: 'Choose a listing plan and complete the payment. You will then receive an email with a link to submit your AI tool's details.'
Full refund promised if the tool does not pass listing criteria
Plans: Basic $79.99 (permanent listing), Featured $99.99, Standard $149.99, Premium $499.99/mo-style exposure package
preparation: AI tool name, URL, description, logo
Email inbox access — the submission-details link arrives by email after payment
workflow: Choose a plan (Basic $79.99 / Featured $99.99 / Standard $149.99 / Premium $499.99) and pay
Log in when prompted (login wall appears around plan selection)
Open the emailed submission link and enter tool details
Team reviews; you are notified by email when the tool is live
watchFor: No free tier at all — even the Basic permanent listing is $79.99
Sponsored/Featured plans cannot be purchased before a Basic or Standard submission exists ('Submission Required' notices)
Premium plan is marketed as limited to 10 companies
Update requests go to info@findmyaitool.com with subject 'Update listing – [Tool Name]'
countsAsLive: AI tool page exists on findmyaitool.com and the tool appears in its category
unknowns: Whether paid placements expire and need renewal
Exact listing criteria used in review
